Standing outside a dark Hörselberg mountain cave entrance, one hand grips a plain sturdy wooden STAFF, the other makes a calm open-palm warning gesture toward viewer. Dim uncanny warm light deep within cave contrasts with cold misty Thuringian forest outside, suggesting guarded Venusberg without depicting any Venus or Wild Hunt. Human appearance is documented; no horns, wings, claws, hollow eyes, giant monstrous anatomy, knight armour, weapons, extra beings or text. Elegant detailed atmospheric brushwork, deep forest-green shadows and restrained antique-gold illumination, main head and hands contained in frame. No writing, signature, watermark, border, gore or unintended extra limbs.
